data.name: [UPDATE] Climb Up Mountain For Brainrot
data.description:
Welcome To Climb Up Mountaint For Brainrot! 🏔️

Upgrade your Jump Boost to get higher up! 🔼

Be ready to get to safety from Avalanches! ❄️

Rebirth to get better and race others to get to the top! 🗻

LIKE AND JOIN GROUP FOR A GOOD STARTER REWARD 🌟

💸 EARNS OFFLINE 💸

Premium Benefits:
Half the waiting time for spin wheels!
